details:
Q1: What should "the code-proven support-checkout fix" change in `implement_heal_preflight.sh`?
Choices:
A. Split each `refuse unavailable` at lines 58-85 into its own reason, and log expected vs. actual SHAs and the ref. Change behaviour only for a defect that a failing test in `tests/test_implement_heal_preflight.py` demonstrates. Every check stays fail-closed. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Option A, plus a dedicated fail-closed reason (e.g. `support_ref_fallback`). It applies when `.codex-workflow-src` was checked out from the `main` fallback in `implement.yml` (lines 975-983) instead of `SCRIPT_REF`. Exact-checkout verification stays mandatory and the fallback is still refused.
C. A specific defect identified in #6778. Paste the failing run ID, or the exact mismatch (expected ref/SHA vs. actual HEAD), in a `/answer`.
Q2: How should the `files_touched` allowlist reach the implement guard?
Choices:
A. Before `/approved`, the pipeline account or an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR edits this issue's body so the block is multiline: a `files_touched:` line on its own, then one `- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh` line and one `- tests/test_implement_heal_preflight.py` line. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The body is already multiline and only looked flattened in the clarify context, so proceed unchanged.
C. Open a fresh issue with the correctly formatted block and close this one.
Q3: Should the change stay strictly within the two listed files?
Choices:
A. Yes, only `scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh` and the new `tests/test_implement_heal_preflight.py`. Add no changelog fragment and don't edit `docs/INVENTORY.md`, `agents.md` or the existing `tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py`. This avoids a general `files_touched` scope rejection. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Also add a `changelog.d/<issue>-heal-preflight-diagnostics.md` fragment, listed in `files_touched`.
**Note:** B only works with Q2:A or Q2:C, because the fragment path has to be added to the allowlist in the body.
